**Labs and practice:** the published English manuscript contains two offline labs. Do not edit the scripts. The sharing print stays:

```text
items 8, sensitive 5, shared too widely 3
  patient-letters/: anyone-with-link
  invoices/: anyone-with-link
  old-backup.zip: anyone-with-link
```

The routine print stays:

```text
May: 3/6 done; missed: check backups restored, update booking app image, read provider security notices
June: 5/6 done; missed: update booking app image
```

Use synthetic data only. Do not replace either print. August's watched routine is not a fourth script key. Fourteen of eighteen is a derivation, not a line in the output.

**Projects and assessment:** score the authored exercises with their 0–3 rubrics. Review of the edition is still open.

**Exercises and answers:** EX001–EX066 have worked results in the manuscript appendix. A planned quota is not an authored exercise. There is no exercise quota.

**References and glossary:** verifiable primary sources and clear terms belong in the authored manuscript; linked project playbooks retain their source rights.
